reviews.title: Just installed in my wife's PC with an i5-13600KF and it's beautiful
reviews.comment: This motherboard is great! It's not for overclockers, so having an OC chip isn't as useful, but it still pairs very well with the motherboard. Installation was easy, fast and painless, as was setting it all up after it was installed. Performance increase from her previous Z390 and 9600K build was immense. I will recommend this board to anyone wanting to run 13-14th gen i5-i9 CPUs.
reviews.author: Bradley Baker

reviews.title: Fantastic motherboard
reviews.comment: I don't really have much to say on this, but I like how there are many pins on it. The motherboard quality is definitely good. But, I don't really see what the need for the RGB on the back is. It doesn't do much to how your pc looks. Personally, I'd prefer for this motherboard to not have any RGB on the back and let my other components do the aesthetic work
